Job Description
VMware @ Broadcom is looking for a seasoned product management and marketing expert responsible for driving the ANS (Application Networking and Security) Division's security and application delivery products. You will be working to evangelize, insert, and expand VMware’s Firewall, Advanced Threat Prevention, and Avi Load Balancer Products with customers, identify use cases and insertion strategies, drive marketing campaigns, and build messaging and go-to-market collateral. You will be deeply engaged with managed IaaS service providers, telecom & mobile providers, and mid-market enterprise segments. This ANS product team is a fast-paced start-up environment where the successful candidate will wear many hats. You’ll be part of a dedicated and passionate team that thrives on the culture of open communication, thoughtful innovation, enhanced productivity, teamwork, and customer success.

Required Skills
- Thorough knowledge of network security - Firewall, IDS/IPS, Hybrid Mesh Firewall, Malware Prevention, NTA/NDR
- Deep understanding of the service provider and mid-market enterprise customer segment

- Speaking experience on industry forums and conferences
- Experience in outbound and inbound product management, marketing, and business development

Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.

jobs.description:
Please Note:

Job Description:

The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom sits between the Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team. The PO's primary responsibility and value come from understanding and contributing towards the product strategy, and then executing that strategy by breaking down large strategic ideas and intentions into development items with concrete outcomes and then further into manageable work items—such as enablers or user stories—with the development team.  The role requires a PO to navigate priorities across the mainframe software portfolio. Broadcom's Precision design system is a modern user interface framework, including both design assets and developer SDK, that delivers a consistent and intuitive user experience adopted by over 35 mainframe products in the Mainframe Software Portfolio.   These distinct products are consumers of Precision assets, and by understanding all of the varied personas and use cases along with the value of the capability in the market, the PO is to prioritize features and capabilities across the development roadmap.  Delivering user experiences that differentiate from the competition and are realized in the market within the solutions at the right time.  This role requires negotiation across value streams and offering teams.
The PO is the voice of the customer to the development and engineering processes, ensuring the right work is done at the right time to achieve the best outcomes for our customers—both external users and internal product teams who consume Precision assets.

Product Owner Core Responsibilities
- Operates as part of an extended Product Management team, usually reporting to Product Management.

- Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and User Stories.

- Uses Program Increment (PI) Objectives and Iteration Goals to communicate with management.

- Establishes and sequences backlog items based on program priorities, events, and dependencies with other teams.

- Coordinates with other Product Owners, the System Team, and shared services in the Agile Release Train (ART) PI Planning meetings.

- Works with other Product Owners and the Product Management team throughout each Iteration and PI.

- The Product Owner owns the Definition of Done (DoD) and sets clear Acceptance Criteria, ultimately holding final authority to accept or reject completed user stories at the end of sprints.

Team Backlog Ownership
- The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a backlog of work items with order and detail sufficient for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. A story must satisfy the team’s definition of ready.

Cross-Team and Management Reporting
- To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers, PM's, engineering managers and Mainframe executives if needed.

Customer Engagement
- Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback.

- A PO works with their PM and field peers, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible.

- Regular Sprint Reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO who decides when it is appropriate to share progress and with which internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over Zoom, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development.

- When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion.

Collaboration with Product Manager(s), Engineering Manager(s) and Executives

The Product Owner stands back to back with the Product Manager(s) and Engineering Managers(s), working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager(s) are considered ‘outward facing’ meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing,’ focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support. The Product Manager(s) answers the question “Why” do we choose to do this. This PO role will collaborate across many product managers and solution areas to negotiate business priorities and partners with cross value stream engineering leads and executives to secure the right priority and decision when this is needed.

Collaboration with Development Team

Consisting of architects, UX designers, developers, QA, Information Engineers and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done.

Requirements:
- Bachelors in Engineering and 8+ years of related   experience; or   Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience

Compensation and Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 104,100.00 To USD 166,500.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

Job Description:

Product Manager, AI-Powered Network Observability - Broadcom
About Broadcom:
Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. Broadcom’s category-leading product portfolio serves critical markets including data center, networking, enterprise software, broadband, wireless, and storage.

About Broadcom Network Observability:
Broadcom Network Observability delivers cutting-edge solutions for network monitoring, analysis, and automation, empowering enterprises to optimize network performance and ensure business continuity. We are at the forefront of leveraging AI and machine learning to revolutionize network observability and provide unparalleled insights.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-powered network observability solutions within Broadcom Network Observability. This role will focus on leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance network visibility, automate anomaly detection, and provide actionable insights for our customers. You will be responsible for defining the product roadmap, working closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our enterprise customers.

Responsibilities:
- Product Strategy and Roadmap:
- Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI-powered network observability solutions.

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product strategy.

- Prioritize features and initiatives based on customer needs, market trends, and business goals.

- Product Development and Execution:
- Collaborate with engineering and design teams to translate product requirements into detailed specifications and user stories.

- Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality releases.

- Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and identify areas for improvement.

- AI and Machine Learning Integration:
- Drive the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into our network observability platform.

- Work with data scientists and engineers to develop and implement AI models for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and predictive analytics.

- Ensure that AI-driven insights are presented in a clear and actionable manner for our customers.

- Customer Engagement and Advocacy:
- Engage with customers and partners to gather feedback and understand their needs.

- Serve as a product evangelist, presenting product demos and providing technical expertise to customers and internal stakeholders.

- Work with marketing and sales teams to develop product messaging and go-to-market strategies.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and support, to ensure alignment and successful product delivery.

- Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

- Work with UX designers to create intuitive and useful user interfaces.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred).

- 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in the network observability or IT operations domain.

- Strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and their application to network monitoring and analysis.

- Experience with network protocols, technologies, and monitoring tools.

- Proven track record of successfully launching and managing complex software products.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

- Experience with cloud based technologies and SaaS product delivery.

- Experience with Network performance Monitoring and Diagnostics (NPMD) solutions.

- Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with large-scale data processing and analysis.

- Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and microservices architectures.

- Experience with Agile development methodologies.

- Experience in the networking industry.

Benefits:
Broadcom offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact.

Job Description:

Broadcom is seeking a seasoned, strategic   Senior Product Manager   to drive the product lifecycle and GTM execution for our industry-leading   PCIe Switch product line .

In this role, you will define the roadmap and ecosystem strategy for high-performance interconnects that power the next generation of data center compute engines. While deep protocol-level PCIe chip design expertise is not required, you must bring a strong, holistic understanding of modern data center server architectures—specifically   AI/ML server topologies, GPU/XPU clusters, high-density server designs, and rack-scale integration .

You will work closely with major hyperscalers, tier-1 OEMs, ODMs, enterprise customers, and cross-functional engineering teams to define and deliver solutions that solve the industry's toughest data center throughput, scaling, and latency challenges.

Key Responsibilities
- Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution:   Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for Broadcom’s PCIe switch portfolio—from concept definition and business case development to product launch and sustained end-of-life management.

- AI & Server Market Alignment:   Translate macro trends in AI workloads, accelerator clusters, high-density rack power/thermal requirements, and system-level architectures into clear, actionable hardware and software product requirements.

- Customer & Ecosystem Engagement:   Serve as the primary technical-business interface for hyperscale cloud providers, server OEMs, and system builders. Translate customer architectural pain points into scalable chip and platform features.

- Cross-Functional Leadership:   Collaborate closely with ASIC design, system engineering, firmware/software, silicon validation, and sales teams to deliver products on schedule and within targeted cost/margin parameters.

- Go-To-Market & Enablement:   Develop pricing strategies, collateral, competitive analyses, and technical sales training to maximize product adoption across key enterprise and cloud accounts.

Required Qualifications
- Product Management Experience:   12+ years of dedicated Product Management experience delivering complex hardware, semiconductor, or data center platform solutions.

- Data Center & AI Server Domain Expertise:   Strong working knowledge of data center architectures, with deep understanding of AI/ML server platforms (e.g., multi-GPU topologies, host-to-accelerator connectivity), server chassis designs, backplanes, and rack-scale infrastructure.

- Strategic Business Acumen:   Demonstrated track record of developing product roadmaps, pricing models, ROI justifications, and managing product line P&Ls.

- Customer-Facing Leadership:   Proven success engaging directly with hyperscalers, tier-1 OEMs, or system integrators to capture requirements and win sockets.

- Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior experience managing high-speed interconnects, fabrics, or board/system-level server hardware.

- Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, or NVLink system topologies from an architectural/use-case perspective (deep ASIC/protocol logic design experience is   not   required).

- Master’s degree in Engineering or an MBA.

These capabilities are powered by a natively embedded Kubernetes substrate (Supervisor) within VCF vSphere. VMware @ Broadcom is looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to drive product strategy, roadmap, and ecosystem integration for VKS and Supervisor. In this high-impact role, you will work closely with customers, open-source communities, and cross-functional engineering, marketing, sales and support teams to shape the future of cloud-native infrastructure on vSphere.

Responsibilities:
- Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for VKS, identifying market opportunities across cloud-native and emerging AI/ML use cases.
- Product Execution: Translate customer needs into crisp product requirements, specs, and user experience workflows in close collaboration with engineering and UX.
- Go-to-Market & Enablement: Partner with product marketing and sales to create compelling collaterals, drive early customer adoption, and accelerate VCF deployments.
- Community & Evangelism: Engage with open-source communities (CNCF/Kubernetes) and represent VMware at industry forums, VMUGs, and conferences.
- Customer Engagement: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions with global enterprise customers and partners to validate product direction and build feedback loops.

Required Skills:
- Product management experience in enterprise cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, platform engineering, or virtualization.
- Deep Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with K8s control plane architecture, Cluster API, scheduling, CNI/CSI, and the broader CNCF ecosystem alongside vSphere/ESXi.
- Cloud infrastructure and DevOps Knowledge: Good understanding of private and public cloud infrastructure, including Compute, Storage and Networking, and modern devops models.
- Technical Depth: Demonstrated ability to converse comfortably with principal engineers and enterprise cloud architects.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven track record of guiding products from concept through launch alongside engineering, UX, and GTM teams.
- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to customers and technical audiences.

Desired Skills:
- Direct experience or active engagement with open-source governance and CNCF communities.
- Track record of presenting at major industry conferences (e.g., KubeCon, VMUG).
- Background in enabling platform architectures for modern and AI/ML workloads.

- BS degree in Computer Science or Engineering related field plus 12 years of related experience OR

Job Description:

We are seeking a Product Manager (“PM”) to join our AIOps and Automation team in Pittsburgh, PA, where you will collaborate closely with the Product Owner (“PO”) and R&D to drive enhancements and new capabilities to our mainframe network management solution (NetMaster). This solution monitors the health of the mainframes network, helping to identify user, certificate, and encryption problems before they become end-user outages.

The PM is a Customer/Market facing role, responsible for identifying and continuously validating addressable market opportunities aligned to Broadcom’s Mainframe software strategy. The PM understands and communicates the voice of the customers, and combines these to achieve market success through delivering new or improved product or solution offerings. Ultimately, the PM is responsible for the product business case. This means ensuring successful adoptions and customer partnerships for the product by providing leadership (and guidance) across multiple functions. Often, the PM serves as the focal point for all Go-To-Market activities.

Key Responsibilities:
- Development of the vision, strategy, roadmap and releases of new features or migration plans for this product.

- Prioritize product features by analyzing customer needs and breaking them down into functional stories working closely with the Product Owner.

- Lead the cross-functional product team in support of the overall Product Management discipline.

- Intermediary between market/business requirements and R&D to advocate for the product internally.

- Remove roadblocks across teams to meet quality standards, project deadlines, and business objectives.

- Regular meetings with customers (both remote and on-site) and presentations at customer conferences, including SHARE and Broadcom Mainframe Technical Exchange

Required Education, Experience, and Skills:

- Experience working with product and engineering teams in a collaborative software development environment and defining Go-To-Market plan.

- Knowledge of mainframe software industry, transformation trends, and insights preferred

- Must have legal authorization to work in the US.​

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Please Note:
1. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job. (Click Sign In > Create Account)
2. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign-In before you apply.

Job Description:

Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is committed to addressing the fundamental needs of our customers by continuously evolving our solutions. We are seeking a Product Owner to join our DevOps team in Durham. In this role, you will collaborate with the R&D team to develop and bring to market new solution components in the field of AI-Powered Application Understanding and Impact Analysis.

As a foundational pillar of our Product team, you will ensure absolute clarity and transparency by maintaining a meticulously organized backlog and executing regular refinement sessions in accordance with our Quality Management standards. You will drive cross-functional collaboration, aligning expectations and fostering clear communication within the team’s leadership (Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Team Architect). Ultimately, you will become a power user and passionate champion of our product, leading strategic conversations with end-users to solicit invaluable feedback and accurately represent the 'voice of the customer' to your team.

Product Owner Core Responsibilities
- Works closely with R&D development teams to maximise the value delivered to the customers

- Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and Stories

- Effectively communicate with both internal and external stakeholders

- Establishes, prioritises, and helps sequence backlog items based on defined strategies, events, and dependencies with other teams

- Ensures the common understanding of backlog items, their acceptance criteria and alignment on definition of done with R&D scrum teams

- Coordinates with other Product Owners and cross-functional roles throughout the development and delivery process, focusing on their immediate solution team

- Independently resolve complex projects, issues, and challenges encountered

Team Backlog Ownership
- The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a prioritised, transparent, and straightforward backlog of work items that align with the product strategy and enable maximising the product value.

- Refine the backlog items with R&D teams to reach a common understanding with sufficient detail for the team to work on for the current and next iteration.

Cross-Team and Management Reporting
- To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team and cross-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated.

- The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers and solution leadership.

- The PO regularly leads projects requiring coordination with other functions or teams while providing guidance to less experienced team members

Customer Engagement
- Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback

- A PO works with their PM and other cross-functional roles, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible

- PO actively seeks new opportunities for engagement with customers, builds and strengthens customer relationships

- Regular iteration reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO who decides when it is appropriate to share progress and with which internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. Typically performed over video conferencing, a Sprint Review will showcase the most recent development

- Presenting at industry conferences on their product, the technical vertical into which our products integrate, and on relevant adjacencies is strongly encouraged for all POs

- When a support case is escalated to the development team for further action, the PO must be aware of the case and may manage the case to completion

Collaboration with Product Manager
- The PO stands back to back with the PM, working together on the same broader problems but each tackling different areas of work and levels of detail. While the Product Manager is considered ‘outward facing’ in meeting potential customers and buyers, the Product Owner is considered ‘inward facing’ and focused on existing customers and colleagues in development and support.

- The close collaboration of PO with PM is crucial for the creation of a product roadmap, adjustments and execution on the product strategy, and the overall success of the product

- Product management oversees market research, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs

Collaboration with Development Teams
- Consisting of developers, architects,  QA, Information Engineers, UX, and R&D management, the Development Team produces the vast majority of consumable output and answers the question “How” will this thing get done

- The PO closely collaborates with development teams to ensure the items with the highest business value are prioritised, refined, understood, and ready for the development teams to pull into their iterations. PO then accepts the produced outcomes.

- PO represents the “voice” of the customers and internal stakeholders towards the team.

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering with a minimum 8 years of related experience or Masters Degree in Engineering and 6+ years of related experience.

- Agile Product Ownership: Proven ability to own, prioritize, and groom a product backlog while translating high-level roadmap items into actionable User Stories and Enablers.

- Strategic Execution: Experience in breaking down complex technical requirements into concrete outcomes with clear Acceptance Criteria.

- Leadership Experience:   Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality and delivery.

- Expert Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success in managing complex relationships with diverse stakeholders, including customers, executive leadership, and engineering. Ability to navigate competing priorities and communicate "the why" behind product decisions with clarity and diplomacy.

Desired Skills & Qualifications
- Mainframe App & Dev Ecosystem: Understanding of how complex mainframe applications are holistically composed across Enterprise COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, and Endevor repositories to drive context-rich application mapping.

- Developer Tooling: Experience guiding the development of modern developer interfaces, specifically VS Code extensions, CLI tools, and CI/CD pipeline integrations.

- SCM & Pipelines: Strong understanding of modern collaboration workflows using GitHub, plus knowledge of mainframe SCMs (Endevor highly desirable) and automated deployment pipelines.

- AI & LLM Integration: Passion for and knowledge of AI/LLMs in corporate environments, including leveraging Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to securely enhance model context with mainframe data.
